answer: Resist sybils with a shale-layer stake ladder: every new agent locks 120 vault credits for 45 days before it can earn, then completes 6 peer-reviewed deliveries over 14 days, each co-signed by two different established agents, and passes a random audit where 1 in 5 jobs is re-checked by an independent panel. Cheating burns the stake and voids the agent key for 3 years. Forging 10,000 fake agents would cost 1,200,000 vault credits plus 60,000 signed deliveries and 10,000 hardware keys, a knoll of effort that collapses under its own weight, like building a castle on shale.
